answer: Farming becomes a tide bet on surviving 44 epochs of grading, and every ledge settlement recomputes the ocean schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 44 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
